name: TJGC Group Limited
summary: TJGC Group Limited, through its subsidiary, Ctrl Media Limited, provides integrated marketing and advertising services in Hong Kong. It offers services to developers of mobile gaming applications that gamers download from the developers' websites and applicable mobile operating systems, such as Apple Store or Android Google Play Store; and advertising services, including planning, creating, launching, managing, and performance monitoring of the advertisements.
